settings.name_in_paper: Stochastic K-armed contextual bandit with QNTK-realizable reward
unmapped: Unknown mean reward h: R^d -> [0,1], modelled through the quantum neural tangent kernel (QNTK) of a randomly initialised quantum neural network with m qubits; the kernel is the empirical QNTK, and its limiting Gram matrix on all TK contexts must be positive definite (min eigenvalue lambda_0 > 0)
The context set X_{1:TK} over the whole horizon is treated as a fixed dataset; whether contexts are adversarial or stochastic is not stated
Noise is nu-sub-Gaussian conditionally on the history
Context vectors have unit l2 norm
QNN architecture assumptions (Assumptions 1-3, from Girardi & De Palma)
settings.definition_quote: At each round $t \in [T]$, the agent observes a set of {\em context vectors} $\mathcal{X}_t = \{\xbf_{t,a}: a \in [K]\}$ ... $r_{t,a_t}=h(\xbf_{t,a_t})+ \xi_t$, where $h: \mathbb{R}^d \to [0, 1]$ is an unknown, $[0,1]$-bounded, mean reward function and $\xi_t$ is $\nu$-sub-Gaussian noise conditioned on the history

symbols.d_q: quantum effective dimension log det(I + Kbar/lambda)/log(1+TK/lambda) of the limiting QNTK Gram matrix on all TK contexts
symbols.m_qubits: number of qubits of the QNN

conditions: number of qubits m = Omega((TK)^3/lambda^2 * log((TK)^2/delta))
S >= sqrt(2 h^T Kbar^{-1} h), with h the vector of mean rewards over all TK contexts
limiting QNTK Gram matrix positive definite with min eigenvalue lambda_0 > 0
QNN architecture satisfies Assumptions 1-3 (Gaussian process limit, convergence of analytic QNTK, light-cone scaling condition)
tuning: beta_{t-1} = nu*sqrt(log det(Z_{t-1})/det(lambda I) + 2 log(1/delta)) + sqrt(lambda)*S

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Fix any $\delta\in(0,1)$. Let $m = \bigOmega\left( \frac{(TK)^3}{\lambda^2}\log\left(\frac{(TK)^2}{\delta}\right) \right)$. Then, with probability at least $1-\delta$, the cumulative regret of QNTK-UCB (Algorithm \ref{alg:qntk-ucb}) satisfies R_T \le 3\sqrt{T}\sqrt{\widetilde{d}_{\mathrm{q}}\log (1+\frac{TK}{\lambda})+1}(\nu\sqrt{...+2\log(1/\delta)}+\sqrt{\lambda}S), where $S \geq \sqrt{2\hbf^\top \bar{\Kbf}^{-1} \hbf}$ ... and $\lambda \geq \max\{1,S^{-2}\}$.

results.notes: Regret R_T is the realized sum of mean-reward gaps (no noise), bounded w.p. 1-delta (over noise and random initialisation). nu (sub-Gaussian parameter) mapped to sigma. Mapping to kernel_rkhs is approximate.

symbols.d_q: quantum effective dimension of the limiting QNTK Gram matrix

conditions: number of qubits m = Omega((TK)^3/lambda^2 * log((TK)^2/delta))
limiting QNTK Gram matrix positive definite

source.label: thm:regret
source.quote: Ignoring logarithmic terms and constants, this bound simplifies to $$ R_T = \tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\widetilde{d}_{\mathrm{q}} \sqrt{T} \right)$$

results.notes: Simplified form of r1; hides S, lambda, nu dependence.

symbols.d_q: quantum effective dimension of the limiting QNTK Gram matrix

conditions: same conditions as Theorem (thm:regret), with delta = 1/T in the qubit-count requirement
limiting QNTK Gram matrix positive definite

source.quote: Under the same conditions as Theorem~\ref{thm:regret}, the expected cumulative regret satisfies $$ \bar{R}_T \le 3\sqrt{T}\sqrt{...}\Big(\nu\sqrt{...+2\log T}+\sqrt{\lambda}S\Big) +1 = \tilde{\mathcal{O}}\left(\widetilde{d}_{\mathrm{q}} \sqrt{T} \right)$$

results.notes: The expected regret is defined as the sum of expected mean-reward gaps, i.e. pseudo-regret. The corollary also states the O_tilde(d_q sqrt(T)) form.
